title: Making Progress on my Voxel God Game inspired by the Black and White Games
author: CapitanUncino19
selftext:
I posted here a while ago sharing an early version and got very good and constructive feedback.

Now many iterations later, I am happy to share some progress.

I used fable to rebuild the entire game on a finer voxel grid. I did a lot of testing and iterating on different gameplay mechanics such as refining the throwing and flicking of trees, the story and gameplay loop. I think this is where AI assisted development really shines: You can just iterate so quickly and try many different things. And if something does not feel great you can just trash it and start over, without having lost weeks.

For the trailer I wrote a storyboard and had opus script the scenes in the game. The soundtrack is made with suno.

The demo can be played here: [https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll](https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll)
